brief: Ukraine's procurement oversight layer is unusually well documented but structurally split: the AMCU appeals board (орган оскарження) issues reasoned complaint decisions, the State Audit Service (Держаудитслужба) publishes per-tender monitoring conclusions (висновки) that by law must appear in the electronic system within three working days, the Accounting Chamber issues long-form audit reports as PDFs, and all of these end up litigated in administrative and commercial courts whose full texts sit in the unified court register (ЄДРСР). The single most collectable channel is the Prozorro central API, where complaints and monitoring artefacts attach directly to the tender record and can be filtered by CPV/keyword for ATM, POS, card and processing procurements; the AMCU site itself is bot-defended (403 on a plain fetch) and exposes no bulk decision export I could confirm. Court material is best taken from the State Judicial Administration's daily-refreshed annual open-data dumps, with Opendatabot, Clarity Project and ZakonOnline as commercial shortcuts for entity-linked lookups. All primary oversight material is Ukrainian-only, so sector filtering must happen inside the corpora rather than through web search — targeted uk queries pairing oversight bodies with banking terms returned only generic process material.
